title: There was an extra guest in my wedding photo 📷
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:09 in the morning I counted the people in my wedding photo and found one more than were invited.

scenes.narration: At 3:09 in the morning I counted the people in my wedding photo and found one more than were invited.
We had forty guests. I know because I wrote every name myself. The framed photo on our hallway wall shows forty one smiling faces.
I took it down and held it under the lamp. The extra person stood at the very back, between my aunt and the door. Pale. Perfectly still.
I rang my sister and asked her to check her copy. She went quiet, and then she said, there are forty one in mine, and he is closer to you.
I checked the album from the photographer. In every shot a pale figure stood a little nearer. In the last picture he was holding my hand.
I put the photo down and went to the bedroom. My husband was asleep. I switched the lamp on, and counted the shapes in the room. Three.
I looked at the empty pillow between us, and the shape was lying there, warm, neatly tucked in, with its head turned toward me.
My husband breathed in his sleep. And the pale one whispered in my ear, in his voice, I was invited. Look at the very first page.
So tell me. Do you open the album, or wake your husband?
